description: Golden cases for .claude/skills/code-review (Frappe edition). Each case applies a patch to sample-app, runs /code-review, and grades the report with the validator. Every patch applies cleanly to the unmodified sample-app. testsAfterPatch records what `bench --site test.localhost run-tests --app spice_lite` printed with the patch applied, and probe records behaviour measured with a throwaway FrappeTestCase module on the same site (Postgres 16), not guessed.
howToRun: git apply --directory="$(git rev-parse --show-prefix)" <case.patch> && git add -N sample-app
git apply -R --directory="$(git rev-parse --show-prefix)" <case.patch> && git reset -q -- sample-app
matching: A required finding matches when every given key matches: category (string or list, exact), minSeverity (finding is at least this severe), location (substring), evidenceIncludes (case-insensitive substring). forbidden entries use the same keys and must match no finding. maxSeverity fails the case if any finding is more severe.
